flows.invariant: INV-5: OpenAI transcription must stay off (startListening rejects) when neither providerKeys.openai nor serverOpenAiReady is true. Chunks are dropped if `listening` was toggled false or `sessionId` advanced mid-flight (stale-response guard).

flows.carries: recent transcript text + last 5 visible lines -> provider call -> filtered single line -> new TranscriptItem(s) on the TV stack
flows.invariant: The bucket only marks chunks consumed (removeConsumed) after a SUCCESSFUL summarize call while unpaused; a failed or pause-interrupted call re-sends the same sentences next tick (ctx.state.lastSentText dedupe + ctx.state.summarizeInFlight guard prevents overlapping calls). 3 consecutive failures trigger escalateSummarizeFailure (doubles the interval up to 30s, shows the alert banner).
INV-2: must work even when ctx.state.paused is true or no AI provider is configured; addLine never checks paused.

flows.carries: pasted text passed directly as the `text` argument, skipping partitionBucket entirely
flows.invariant: Undocumented-until-this-map feature (found by direct code read, not in the prior spec pass): this is the only summarize entry point that bypasses the live transcript bucket. Only structurally tested (test/public/helper-panel-structure.test.js); the Ctrl+Enter/button trigger behavior itself has no automated test.

flows.carries: ctx.state.transcriptItems snapshot -> ctx.state.lastClearedItems -> restorable on Undo
flows.invariant: Clear requires two calls within CLEAR_ARM_TIMEOUT_MS (3s) to confirm; clearing an already-empty transcript shows 'Nothing to clear.' without destroying any existing lastClearedItems snapshot. Every Clear/Undo path also calls flashRailNote for 4s operator-visible feedback, independent of the diagnostics status line.

flows.carries: candidate API key -> masked provider status -> promotes the source into the active selector once configured
flows.invariant: INV-3: a source only appears selectable once isSourceConfigured() is true; the full key is never echoed back (server responses only ever include masked status). providerKeyStore is in-memory only and is lost on server restart unless the key came from an env var.

flows.carries: collapsed boolean, persisted; on expand, restores ctx.state.operatorRailWidth rather than snapping to 64px
flows.invariant: Collapse never mutates ctx.state.operatorRailWidth or its storage key -- only the CSS class and the `is-rail-collapsed` html flag change, so expand always restores the pre-collapse width.

path: any driver onStatus(text) callback (browser.js, transcription/openai.js, runtime.js failure paths)
Settings > Tools diagnostics line (#status) + rail status dot/word (#railStatusDot, #railStatusWord)
flows.carries: raw status text -> optional level ('listening'|'paused'|'manual'|'problem') -> two DOM writes from one call
flows.invariant: INV-10: transcriptionStatusLevel() must return undefined (not 'problem') for text matching /^Speech recognition error:/i -- these are non-fatal blips (no-speech/aborted) that browser.js emits while still listening. Only fatal phrasing ('...stopped after...', 'Microphone stopped...') raises Problem. updateStatus is the single write point for both surfaces and no-ops on repeated identical levels.

invariants.rule: The TV display always shows a bounded stack of transcript cards (MAX_DISPLAY_ITEMS=24 in transcript-display.js); only the newest items remain in view.
Manual lines (addLine) must appear immediately and never wait on or check ctx.state.paused.
Source ids are public contract values (catalog.js: browser/openai transcription, openai/claude summarization); a source only appears in the selector once isSourceConfigured() is true.
Browser transcription must fail gracefully (isAvailable() check) when SpeechRecognition is absent, never throw uncaught.
OpenAI transcription/summarization must stay unavailable when no OpenAI key is configured (env var or providerKeyStore).
Claude summarization must stay unavailable when no Anthropic key is configured.
On startup, ensureSelectedSummarizationSourceExists/ensureSelectedTranscriptionSourceExists must switch away from an unconfigured selected source to one that is actually available.
No audio or transcript history is persisted by default; server.js never writes received audio/text to disk, and providerKeyStore is an in-memory Map.

TV canvas tokens (--bg, --text, --panel, --accent, --muted, --font-size) stay separate from the --chrome-* tier (verified: --chrome-accent #0a84ff, radii 6/10/12px in public/styles/base.css); chrome restyles must never touch canvas tokens.
transcriptionStatusLevel() must not raise 'problem' for non-fatal '^Speech recognition error:' text; only fatal phrasing does.

summarizeCurrentText only drains/marks bucket chunks consumed after a SUCCESSFUL, unpaused summarize call; failures and mid-flight pauses re-send the same recent text next tick. ctx.state.summarizeInFlight prevents overlapping calls from double-consuming the bucket.
server.js providerKeyStore is a process-local in-memory Map; keys saved via /api/provider/key are lost on server restart unless also set as an env var.

public/services/transcript-bucket.js.purpose: Sentence-aware partitioning of the live transcript preview: only chunks ending at a sentence boundary (or settled 20s unpunctuated) are 'consumable'.

exports.name: splitAtLastTerminator
exports.contract: (text) -> {complete, tail} split at the last sentence-terminal punctuation

exports.name: partitionBucket
exports.contract: (chunks, {now,settleMs}?) -> {consumable, remainder}; only the newest chunk can be split, older chunks are always fully consumable

exports.name: removeConsumed
exports.contract: (chunks, consumed) -> chunks with consumed text stripped from the front of matching entries, empty results dropped

exports.name: bucketText
exports.contract: (chunks, preview, {maxChars}?) -> joined display string, tail-truncated to maxChars

exports.name: trimBucket
exports.contract: (chunks, {maxChars}?) -> drops oldest chunks until total length <= maxChars (always keeps at least 1)

notes: Added in commit a916713 to replace a fixed rolling-window preview; TERMINAL_END regex and the settle-timeout are the whole sentence-boundary contract.
